# Start a task

Ordinary task-start wrapper over the local kernel start API 0x600307dd.

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x600697ff` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-planned">Single source</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [pen-f firmware 3.1, build 3101](../firmware/pen-f-3101.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus PEN-F](../cameras/pen-f.md)

The static descriptor sets hold 140 CPU0, 49 CPU1 and 21 CPU2 tasks; only the first initial task starts automatically.
